name: poly-e2e-language-defaults
displayName: poly e2e: a language default another extension ships
description: Loaded beside poly-lsp in the e2e host and nowhere else. golang.go ships `[go]` format-on-save as a language default, which outranks a global `editor.formatOnSave: false` -- the reason a global-only format toggle leaves Go formatting on save. This ships the same shape for `[bat]`, a language no other test touches, so the Format switch can be tested against it without golang.go.
